(2) A quick cut shows a pink screen with a graphic of the woman holding a product box, surrounded by heart icons and marketing text. (3) Back on the sofa, she talks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands and holding the pink box labeled with a peach icon. The lighting is bright and warm. (4) A sequence of interview clips follows: first, a woman in a black cap and grey tank top speaks in a bedroom-like setting; second, a woman in a purple top with pink bows in her hair shares her experience; third, a woman in a black low-cut top with braces smiles widely. (5) The main woman returns, excitedly announcing a giveaway while graphics of multiple pink boxes and gold confetti appear around her. She holds up two and three fingers to emphasize the numbers. (6) Several full-screen graphic overlays appear, detailing promotional prices, bundle deals, and social media handles with a pink and summer-themed background. (7) Finally, she points to her smartphone screen showing her Instagram profile and a link, waving goodbye with a bright smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop BGM featuring a steady synthesizer pulse and a clear 4/4 electronic drum beat. A female voice (Yuci) speaks rapidly with a bright, high-arousal tone, expressing nervousness. (2) A 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a change as she transitions to explaining the product. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) A series of short 'ding' and 'pop' SFX accompany the appearance of variety-show style text on screen. The vocal tone is persuasive and enthusiastic. (4) The audio switches to interview segments where three distinct female voices speak. Their pitch is slightly lower and their pace more measured, conveying sincere testimonials, while the BGM ducks slightly to maintain clarity. (5) A 'sparkle' SFX triggers as Yuci returns to announce the giveaway. Her voice rises in pitch and intensity. (6) The video concludes with the BGM swelling in volume before a clean hard cut at the end.
